detail.limitations: Seed-scale, one Docker host; p95 uses nearest rank (7 samples), not a capacity benchmark.

Q1.sql: SELECT product_id, title, site_id FROM site_b.product ORDER BY product_id

Q2.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.title, c.name AS category_name, p.site_id
FROM v_product p JOIN v_category c USING (category_id)
WHERE NOT p.is_deleted ORDER BY p.product_id

Q3.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.title, p.site_id, i.image_id, i.image_url
FROM v_product p LEFT JOIN v_product_image i USING (product_id)
WHERE p.product_id = :'product_id'::integer ORDER BY i.image_id

Q4.sql:
SELECT c.category_id, c.name, count(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM v_category c LEFT JOIN v_product p ON p.category_id = c.category_id AND NOT p.is_deleted
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY c.category_id

Q5.sql:
SELECT c.category_id, c.name, count(p.product_id) AS product_count, avg(p.price) AS average_price
FROM v_category c LEFT JOIN v_product p ON p.category_id = c.category_id AND NOT p.is_deleted
    AND p.created_at >= :'from_date'::timestamp AND p.created_at < :'to_date'::timestamp
GROUP BY c.category_id, c.name ORDER BY c.category_id

Q6.sql:
SELECT s.seller_id, s.site_id FROM v_seller_site s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM v_product p WHERE p.seller_id = s.seller_id AND NOT p.is_deleted
        AND p.created_at >= :'from_date'::timestamp AND p.created_at < :'to_date'::timestamp
) ORDER BY s.seller_id
